<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Страница-1" id="VvlxhjekOMVhKax4JS8m"> <mxGraphModel dx="4839" dy="1948" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph LR
 %% =========================================================================
 %% TIER-1 INSTITUTIONAL BRANDING & PALETTE (Enterprise Monochrome Standard)
 %% =========================================================================
 classDef default fill:#ffffff,stroke:#1e293b,stroke-width:1px,color:#0f172a;
 classDef infrastructure fill:#ffffff,stroke:#64748b,stroke-width:1px,color:#334155,stroke-dasharray: 4 4;
 classDef coreLogic fill:#f8fafc,stroke:#0f172a,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#0f172a,font-weight:bold;
 classDef riskSystem fill:#fff5f5,stroke:#991b1b,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#7f1d1d,font-weight:bold;

 %% =========================================================================
 %% LAYER 01: EXTERNAL INFRASTRUCTURE
 %% =========================================================================
 subgraph L1 [\"LAYER 01 : EXTERNAL INFRASTRUCTURE\"]
 bybit_exchange[\"External System: Bybit Exchange<br>• API v5 &amp; UTA Portfolio Margin\"] --> public_ws[\"System Boundary: Public WebSocket<br>• Real-time IV &amp; Spreads Feed\"]
 bybit_exchange --> private_rest[\"System Boundary: Private REST Port<br>• TIMS Exchange Risk Vectors\"]
 bybit_exchange --> account_equity[\"System Boundary: Account Ledger<br>• Live Portfolio Total Equity E\"]
 end
 class bybit_exchange,public_ws,private_rest,account_equity infrastructure;

 %% =========================================================================
 %% LAYER 02: AUTONOMOUS CORE LOGIC
 %% =========================================================================
 subgraph L2 [\"LAYER 02 : AUTONOMOUS CORE LOGIC\"]
 entry_gate[\"Container: Ingestion Gate<br>• Trigger: Mon 11:30 VLV Execution\"] --> target_engine[\"Container: Dual Target Engine<br>• Logic: Straddle/Strangle Scan\"]
 target_engine --> strangle_pos[\"Container: Position State Registry<br>• Target: Calendar Ratio Strangle\"]
 strangle_pos --> state_core[\"Container: State Core &amp; Delta Netter<br>• Core: Thread-Safe RAM Matrix\"]
 capital_manager[\"Container: Capital Allocation<br>• Logic: Scaling &amp; Volatility Sizing\"] --> opt_pool[\"Component: Options Margin Buffer<br>• Allocation: 55% Initial Margin Lock\"]
 capital_manager --> savings_buffer[\"Component: Savings Rate Netter<br>• Allocation: 45% Dynamic Yield Vault\"]
 end
 class capital_manager,opt_pool,savings_buffer,target_engine,strangle_pos coreLogic;
 class entry_gate,state_core riskSystem;

 %% =========================================================================
 %% LAYER 03 &amp; 04: INTRADAY RUNTIME &amp; FEEDBACK CONTROL
 %% =========================================================================
 subgraph L3_L4 [\"LAYER 03 &amp; 04 : INTRADAY RUNTIME &amp; FEEDBACK CONTROL\"]
 %% Высокочастотный HFT контур и исполнители
 hft_scalper[\"Component: HFT Locked-Scalper<br>• Microsecond Gamma/Vega Scalping\"] --> delta_flatten[\"Execution State: Delta-Flattening<br>• Trigger: Boundary Breach Violations\"]
 delta_flatten ---> rate_limiter[\"WS Rate-Limiter<br>• Interface: create-batch Filter\"]
 rate_limiter == 02. Rate Throttle ==> hft_scalper

 sor_router[\"Component: SOR Basis Router<br>• Smart Order Routing Engine\"] --> quarterly_fut[\"External: Quarterly Futures<br>• Linear Delivery Hedging\"]
 sor_router --> perp_fut[\"External: Perpetual Swaps<br>• Linear Continuous Hedging\"]
 perp_fut ---> amend_instr[\"Chaser Instruction<br>• Interface: v5/order/amend RPC\"]
 amend_instr == 01. Amend Update ==> perp_fut

 %% Асинхронное логирование стейта
 state_core ===> chan_io[\"Non-blocking Go Channel<br>• IO Engine: Disk State File Writer\"]

 %% Системный контур синхронизации ОЗУ (МЬЮТЕКСЫ ПОДКЛЮЧЕНЫ)
 state_core ===> mutex_lock[\"Segmented Mutices<br>• Primitives: marginMu / greeksMu\"]
 mutex_lock == 03. Memory Sync ==> state_core
%% Контур превентивной защиты и хвостового риска
 preemptive_prot[\"Component: Preemptive Protection<br>• Server-Side Co-located Safety Trigger\"] --> tokyo_node[\"Infrastructure: Bybit Tokyo Node<br>• AWS ap-northeast-1 / 0 ms Cross\"]
 margin_shield[\"Component: Dynamic Margin Shield<br>• Tail-Risk Exposure Liquidator\"] --> otm_tails[\"Protective OTM Tails<br>• Preemptive Tail-Risk Protection\"]
 otm_tails ---> savings_pool[\"Dynamic Savings Pool<br>• Margin Call Capital Pull Engine\"]
 savings_pool == 05. Capital Recall ==> savings_buffer
 end
 class sor_router,quarterly_fut,perp_fut,hft_scalper,delta_flatten coreLogic;
 class margin_shield,otm_tails,preemptive_prot,tokyo_node,mutex_lock,rate_limiter,chan_io,amend_instr,savings_pool riskSystem;

 %% =========================================================================
 %% LAYER 05: LIFECYCLE SETTLEMENT &amp; EMERGENCY BREAKERS
 %% =========================================================================
 subgraph L5 [\"LAYER 05 : LIFECYCLE SETTLEMENT &amp; EMERGENCY BREAKERS\"]
 time_check[\"Lifecycle Event: Weekly Settlement<br>• Schedule: Friday 18:00 VLV / 5 DTE Expiry\"] --> kill_switch[\"Component: Block Trading SOR Demontage<br>• Action: Liquidation Position Takedown\"] --> usdc_cash_1[\"Terminal State: 100% USDC Liquidity<br>• Vault: Offline Settlement Storage\"]
 time_check ---> emergency_lock[\"Component: Emergency OCO-Lock<br>• Action: API Interruption Protection\"] ---> weekend_holding[\"Risk State: Delta-Locked Exposure<br>• Strategy: Safe Weekend Position Mode\"] ---> unwind_engine[\"Component: Liquidity-Driven Unwind<br>• Action: Cascading Market Cleansing\"] ---> usdc_cash_2[\"Terminal State: 100% USDC Liquidity<br>• Vault: Emergency Safe Mode Capital\"]
 end
 class kill_switch,usdc_cash_1,unwind_engine coreLogic;
 class time_check,emergency_lock,weekend_holding,usdc_cash_2 riskSystem;

 %% Магистральные коннекторы слоев
 public_ws ===> entry_gate
 private_rest ---> entry_gate
 account_equity ---> capital_manager
 opt_pool -.-> state_core
 
 state_core ===> hft_scalper
 state_core ===> sor_router
 state_core ---> preemptive_prot
 state_core ---> margin_shield

 %% Сквозной выход на закрытие сессии
 quarterly_fut &amp; perp_fut &amp; tokyo_node &amp; otm_tails ===> time_check
